name: async-datasource-callback-contracts

evidence.notes: Async DML accepts a local DataSource async save callback object in test context.
Local async insert/update invokes processSave with the materialized SaveResult.
Async DML accepts a local DataSource async delete callback object in test context.
Local async delete invokes processDelete with the materialized DeleteResult.
Single-record async insert callback overload runs through local DML and invokes the callback.
Single-record async update callback overload runs through local DML and invokes the callback.
Single-record async delete callback overload runs through local DML and invokes the callback.
Single-record async insert callback overload without an access level runs through local DML and invokes the callback.
Single-record async update callback overload without an access level runs through local DML and invokes the callback.
Single-record async delete callback overload without an access level runs through local DML and invokes the callback.

source.content: public class AsyncSaveProbe extends DataSource.AsyncSaveCallback { public static Integer calls = 0; public static Id lastId; public override void processSave(Database.SaveResult result) { calls++; if (result != null) { lastId = result.getId(); } } }

public class AsyncDeleteProbe extends DataSource.AsyncDeleteCallback { public static Integer calls = 0; public static Id lastId; public override void processDelete(Database.DeleteResult result) { calls++; if (result != null) { lastId = result.getId(); } } }

@isTest private class AsyncDataSourceCallbackContractsTest { @isTest static void callbacksReceiveLocalResults() { AsyncSaveProbe saveCallback = new AsyncSaveProbe(); Account inserted = new Account(Name = 'callback insert'); Database.SaveResult insertResult = Database.insertAsync(inserted, saveCallback, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(insertResult.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(insertResult.getId(), AsyncSaveProbe.lastId); Account updateRecord = new Account(Id = insertResult.getId(), Name = 'callback update'); Database.SaveResult updateResult = Database.updateAsync(updateRecord, saveCallback, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(updateResult.isSuccess()); AsyncDeleteProbe deleteCallback = new AsyncDeleteProbe(); Database.DeleteResult deleteResult = Database.deleteAsync(updateRecord, deleteCallback, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(deleteResult.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(deleteResult.getId(), AsyncDeleteProbe.lastId); Database.SaveResult defaultInsertResult = Database.insertAsync(new Account(Name = 'callback insert default'), saveCallback); System.assert(defaultInsertResult.isSuccess()); Account defaultUpdateRecord = new Account(Id = defaultInsertResult.getId(), Name = 'callback update default'); Database.SaveResult defaultUpdateResult = Database.updateAsync(defaultUpdateRecord, saveCallback); System.assert(defaultUpdateResult.isSuccess()); Database.DeleteResult defaultDeleteResult = Database.deleteAsync(defaultUpdateRecord, deleteCallback); System.assert(defaultDeleteResult.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(defaultDeleteResult.getId(), AsyncDeleteProbe.lastId); System.assertEquals(4, AsyncSaveProbe.calls); System.assertEquals(2, AsyncDeleteProbe.calls); } }
